CONNECT_NO_FIVEM: Sign in to your FiveM (Cfx.re) account to join this server.
KEYS_HINT: Point at a key to see what it does
PICKER_HINT: Click adds 1, Ctrl + click 10, Shift + click 100
PICKER_LIST_EMPTY: Click items on the left to add them here
PICKER_HEAVY: That would go over the weight limit
CHAR_CREATE_SUBTITLE: Slot {0}. You can change your look after you spawn.
CHAR_DELETE_TEXT: Their money, jobs, gangs and everything they own go with them. This cannot be undone.
CHAR_ERR_BUSY: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
CHAR_ERR_INVALID: Check the form and try again.
CHAR_ERR_BIRTHDATE: Pick a date of birth for an age between 18 and 100.
CHAR_ERR_LIMIT: All character slots are in use.
CHAR_ERR_ONLINE: This character is already in the game.
CHAR_ERR_NO_DELETE: Deleting characters is turned off on this server.
ADMIN_EMPTY_LIST: Nothing here yet. Use the button above to add the first one.
ADMIN_PICK_RECORD: Pick one from the list to edit it.
ADMIN_IMPORT_DESC: Paste records copied with Copy all as JSON (here or on another server). Each one is checked like an edit; when one is wrong nothing is imported and the problem is shown.
ADMIN_IMPORT_BAD: This is not a list of records ({ "key": { ... } }).
ADMIN_IMPORT_COUNT: {0} new, {1} with a key that exists
ADMIN_CREATE_DESC: Give it a name. Everything else can be set after it is created.
ADMIN_DELETE_DESC: It is removed for everyone at once. Players who have it keep the old value until it is set again.
ADMIN_H_KEY: Saved under this key and used by scripts. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
ADMIN_ERR_TYPE: This value is not valid here.
ADMIN_ERR_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
ADMIN_ERR_LENGTH: This text is too short or too long.
ADMIN_ERR_PATTERN: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
ADMIN_ERR_EXISTS: Something with this key already exists. Pick another key.
ADMIN_ERR_LOCKED: This one is built in and cannot be deleted.
ADMIN_ERR_DENIED: You no longer have admin rights.
ADMIN_ERR_RATE: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
ADMIN_ERR_GONE: This script is not running right now.
ADMIN_ERR_BUSY: Unable to save. Check your connection and try again.
ADMIN_TAB_GENERAL_DESC: The server name players see, character slots and how often the game saves.
ADMIN_TAB_SPAWN_DESC: Where new characters appear, and where players may choose to appear after picking a character.
ADMIN_TAB_SCENE_DESC: The place in the world behind the character screen, where each player's characters stand.
ADMIN_TAB_RULES_DESC: How many jobs and gangs a character may hold and how salaries are paid.
ADMIN_TAB_JOBS_DESC: Every job on the server with its ranks and salaries.
ADMIN_TAB_GANGS_DESC: Every gang on the server with its ranks.
ADMIN_TAB_ACCOUNTS_DESC: The kinds of money every character has and what a new character starts with.
ADMIN_C_BRANDING_DESC: Shown at the top of the character screen and other full screen menus.
ADMIN_PH_TAGLINE_SUB: e.g. People, stories, a second chance
ADMIN_H_BACKGROUND: Shown behind the character screen only when its scene cannot be loaded.
ADMIN_C_CHARACTERS_DESC: How many characters an account may have and who may create one.
ADMIN_H_SLOTS: Slots on the character screen for every account.
ADMIN_H_CAN_DELETE: Off hides the delete button on the character screen.
ADMIN_C_CHARACTER_SCREEN_DESC: ai-core has its own character screen. When you install another one (tgiann-multichar, qb-multicharacter, esx_multicharacter...), ai-core switches its own off by itself and lets that one log players in.
ADMIN_H_CHARACTER_SCREEN: Automatic uses an installed character script while it runs, else ai-core's. A picked script that is not running leaves ai-core's screen on, so players can always join.
ADMIN_H_CHARACTER_SCREEN_ACTIVE: The character screen players see right now.
ADMIN_H_FRAMEWORK_TABLES: Character scripts read the players, users, jobs and job_grades tables of ESX and QB. ai-core fills them with the characters of connected players; deleting a character there deletes it in ai-core too. Automatic makes them only while another character screen runs. Tables of the same name that ai-core did not make are never touched.
ADMIN_C_SAVING_DESC: Positions and other small changes are saved together on this interval. Money is always saved at once.
ADMIN_C_INVENTORY_DESC: Every script gives, takes and checks items through this inventory.
ADMIN_H_INVENTORY: Automatic uses the first one that runs. A picked inventory that is not started leaves every item action failing until it starts.
ADMIN_TAB_EXTERNAL_DESC: Settings screens of other scripts, listed under Other panels in the sidebar and on the dashboard.
ADMIN_C_EXTERNAL_DESC: How the dashboard opens this script's own settings: its command, or its page shown inside the panel.
ADMIN_H_EXT_RESOURCE: Resource name; the card shows only while it is started. Leave empty for a page that belongs to no script.
ADMIN_H_EXT_COMMAND: The command that opens the script's own panel. ai-core's panel closes and runs it for you.
ADMIN_H_EXT_URL: An https page shown inside the panel (a script's NUI page: https://cfx-nui-<script>/...). Pages that need their own script's messages work only through the command.
ADMIN_DASHBOARD_DESC: Every script with settings. Search finds scripts, tabs, settings and records.
ADMIN_C_PED_DESC: A person standing at this place (a clerk, a shopkeeper). Leave the model empty for none.
ADMIN_H_PED_MODEL: The ped model; empty means no NPC. Players see it within 50 m.
ADMIN_H_PED_SCENARIO: An idle animation the NPC plays on the spot.
ADMIN_H_PED_POSITION: The NPC's floor spot and the way it faces (scroll in the free camera); without one it stands on the place's point.
ADMIN_MODEL_CUSTOM: Not in the game's list: press Enter to keep the typed name (an addon model).
ADMIN_FREECAM_HELP: WASD move · Q/E down/up · Shift fast · mouse look · scroll rotate · Enter place · Backspace cancel
ADMIN_SUGGEST_HINT: Names of the street and area here
ADMIN_BLIP_SEARCH: Search icons by name or number
ADMIN_ERR_LOOKUP: Pick a value that exists in the game.
ADMIN_LOOKUP_EMPTY: No match. Only existing values can be picked.
ADMIN_C_CONFLICTS_DESC: When a script that replaces another runs (tgiann-inventory instead of ai-inventory), the console names the folder to delete.
ADMIN_H_REFUSE_ON_CONFLICT: Nobody can join while an unneeded script is started next to its replacement; the refusal and the console say which one to remove.
CONNECT_CONFLICT: This server is not set up correctly: {0} must be removed because another script replaces it. Tell the server owner.
ADMIN_C_UPDATES_DESC: Scripts with a GitHub repository are compared with their latest release; outdated ones show here on the dashboard and in the server console.
ADMIN_H_UPDATES_CHECK: Asks GitHub once every 6 hours per script (and when a script starts). Off: nothing is asked.
ADMIN_H_UPDATES_IGNORE: Scripts left out of the check (your own edited copies, scripts you keep on an older version on purpose).
ADMIN_C_RECOMMENDATIONS_DESC: Scripts ai-core recommends for this server show on the dashboard and once in the server console at start. The ones you dismissed are listed here.
ADMIN_H_RECOMMENDATIONS_DISMISSED: Recommendations dismissed from the dashboard. Remove one to show it again.
ADMIN_REC_TGIANN_PHONE_DESC: No phone script runs: tgiann-phone gives players calls, messages and apps, and every script reaches it through ai-core's phone layer.
ADMIN_REC_TGIANN_ESC_MAP_DESC: A day and night pause map with a searchable blip panel, blip categories and postal numbers.
ADMIN_C_INTERACTION_DESC: How players use shops, counters, NPCs and other points of every script.
ADMIN_H_INTERACTION: Prompt: a box on the right and the interaction key when close. Target: players hold the target key and pick the option on the point or NPC (needs a target script such as ai-target; without one the prompt is used).
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_KEYS_DESC: Every script gives, takes and checks vehicle keys through this key system.
ADMIN_H_VEHICLE_KEYS: Automatic uses the first one that runs. While no key script runs, every player counts as holding every key.
ADMIN_C_DISPATCH_DESC: Every script sends its police alerts (robberies, shots, drug sales) through this alert system.
ADMIN_H_DISPATCH: Automatic uses the first one that runs; ai-policealert's alert cards come last.
ADMIN_C_APPEARANCE_DESC: Every script reads characters' saved looks and dresses peds (character screen, sleeping bodies) through this clothing script.
ADMIN_H_APPEARANCE: Automatic uses the first one that runs; ai-appearance comes last.
ADMIN_C_BILLING_DESC: Every script sends its bills (police fines, mechanic and medic fees) through this billing script.
ADMIN_H_BILLING: Automatic uses the first one that runs; without one, ai-core's own bills: the player pays from a list on screen and the money moves then.
ADMIN_C_BANKING_DESC: Scripts open bank screens and read job account balances through this banking script.
ADMIN_H_BANKING: Automatic uses the first one that runs.
ADMIN_H_BANK_ACCOUNTS: ai-core's accounts: ai-core keeps the job and gang money and the banking script shows the same balance; money moved on its screen is moved in ai-core too. At every start and when picked, the script's job and gang balances are set to ai-core's. The script's own accounts: the script keeps the money, and paychecks, bills and other scripts take from and pay into its accounts. Which scripts support each mode is in the compatibility notes.
ADMIN_C_MDT_DESC: Fines, arrests and jail sentences are written into this MDT.
ADMIN_H_MDT: Automatic uses the first one that runs; without one nothing is written.
ADMIN_C_EMS_DESC: How many medics are free (hospital check-in) and distress calls of downed players.
ADMIN_H_EMS: Automatic uses the first one that runs; what it does not answer, ai-core answers from its duty counts and the police alert system.
BILL_ERR_GONE: This bill is no longer open
BILL_ERR_SENDER_AWAY: Whoever sent this bill is not in the city: pay it later
ADMIN_C_FUEL_DESC: Every script reads and sets vehicles' fuel (garages, rentals, admin cars) through this fuel script.
ADMIN_H_FUEL: Automatic uses the first one that runs; ai-fuel comes first.
ADMIN_C_DOORLOCK_DESC: Scripts lock and unlock doors (robberies, prisons) through this door lock script, by its own door ids.
ADMIN_H_DOORLOCK: Automatic uses the first one that runs; ai-doorlock comes first.
ADMIN_C_GARAGES_DESC: Scripts impound vehicles, store them and open garage menus through this garage script.
ADMIN_H_GARAGES: Automatic uses the first one that runs; ai-garages comes first.
ADMIN_C_NOTIFY_DESC: Where the notifications of every script show: ai-lib's own cards or another notification script you installed.
ADMIN_H_NOTIFY: ai-lib shows its own cards. A script picked here is used while it runs; when it stops, ai-lib's cards come back.
ADMIN_C_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC: Where a new character appears after it is created.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_LOOK_DESC: Camera zoom, and the time and weather players see while they pick a character.
ADMIN_H_FOV: Smaller is closer. 50 is a good start.
ADMIN_H_SCENE_TIME: Off shows the server's current time and weather.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_SPOTS_DESC: Spot 1 holds the character of slot 1, and so on. A character in a slot without a spot appears on a spot only while it is picked.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_CAMERAS_DESC: How the camera frames the character on each spot when it is picked.
ADMIN_H_CAM_HEIGHT: 0 is level with the look point, 0.5 raises the camera by half the distance, below 0 looks up.
ADMIN_H_CAM_ANGLE: 0 is straight in front of the character, 90 its left side, -90 its right side.
ADMIN_H_SWAY: How far the camera slowly swings left and right. 0 keeps it still.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_BLUR_DESC: Blurs what is nearer or farther than the character, like a photo lens.
ADMIN_H_BLUR: Sharp from the near distance to the far distance from the camera, blurred outside.
ADMIN_C_JOB_RULES_DESC: A character works one job at a time; salary comes only from the job they are on duty in.
ADMIN_H_MULTI_JOB: Off: a new job replaces the old one.
ADMIN_H_RESTORE_DUTY: Off: every player starts off duty.
ADMIN_C_GANG_RULES_DESC: A character can be in several gangs but acts for one active gang at a time.
ADMIN_C_PAYCHECK_DESC: Players on duty are paid the salary of their rank on this interval.
ADMIN_F_FROM_JOB_ACCOUNT: Pay from the job's own money
ADMIN_H_FROM_JOB_ACCOUNT: Off: the server pays. On: the job account pays, and nobody is paid when it is empty.
ADMIN_C_PRIME_TIME_DESC: The busy hours of the day. Outside them salaries can be lowered, so players work when the server is full.
ADMIN_H_PRIME_ENABLED: Off: full salary all day. The hours still answer scripts that ask whether it is prime time.
ADMIN_H_OFF_PRIME_MULTIPLIER: 0.5 pays half the salary, 1 the full salary. A rank with its own off prime salary gets that instead.
ADMIN_H_PRIME_SOURCE: Automatic uses the hours of a script that keeps its own (tgiann-policealert: config.primeTime in its config.lua) while it runs, else the hours below. A picked script that is stopped pays full salary all day.
ADMIN_H_PRIME_ACTIVE: Which hours decide prime time at the moment: the hours set here or a script's name.
ADMIN_O_PRIME_ACTIVE_NONE: None: the picked script is stopped, full salary all day
ADMIN_C_JOB_PRIME_DESC: Prime hours of this job while ai-core's own hours are used (Job and gang rules, Prime time); without them the default hours apply.
ADMIN_H_PRIME_OWN: Off: the default hours of Job and gang rules. An end before the start runs past midnight.
ADMIN_H_JOB_TYPE: Groups jobs for other scripts, e.g. leo for every police job, ems for medics.
ADMIN_H_DEFAULT_DUTY: Players start this job on duty instead of off duty.
ADMIN_H_JOB_LISTED: Anyone may take this job at a job center (ESX job listing). Off: only an admin or a boss hands it out.
ADMIN_C_GRADES_DESC: From the lowest to the highest rank. The salary is paid on every paycheck while on duty; the off prime salary replaces it outside prime time (0 = salary x the factor in Job and gang rules).
ADMIN_C_GANG_GRADES_DESC: From the lowest to the highest rank.
ADMIN_H_START: What a new character has in this account.
ADMIN_H_NEGATIVE: On: spending is allowed with an empty account (debt).
ADMIN_TAB_KEYBINDS_DESC: The key every script's action starts on; players can still change theirs in GTA settings.
ADMIN_C_KEYBIND_DESC: The script sets a default key; set another one here to give every player a different starting key.
ADMIN_H_DEFAULT_KEY: Empty uses the script's key. A new key reaches every player (also those who had changed the old one) the next time the script starts or they reconnect; players can still rebind it in GTA Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM.
ADMIN_ERR_KEY: Unknown key name for this device. Keyboard: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, TAB, LSHIFT, LMENU (Alt), RETURN, BACK. Mouse: MOUSE_LEFT, MOUSE_RIGHT, MOUSE_MIDDLE.
ADMIN_TAB_COMMANDS_DESC: Every command on the server: what it does, how to type it and who may use it.
COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED: You are not allowed to use this command.
COMMAND_PLAYER: No player is online with id {0}.
COMMAND_AICORE_JOB: Give a job at a grade
COMMAND_AICORE_DUTY: Go on duty in a job (off = off duty)
COMMAND_AICORE_MONEY: Add to an account (a negative amount takes)
COMMAND_AICORE_GANG: Give a gang at a grade
COMMAND_AICORE_DB: Database statistics of every resource in the server console
COMMAND_P_ID: Server id of the player (default: you)
COMMAND_AICORE_ALERT: Send a test police alert at your position
DISPATCH_TEST_MESSAGE: Sent by an admin to test the alerts
ADMIN_SEARCH_HINT: A setting, a tab, a script or a record (a shop, a job, a door)...
ADMIN_SEARCH_START: Type what you want to change: "fuel", "seat belt", "police", "blip"...
SETUP_WELCOME_ADMIN: This server has not been set up yet. Open the admin panel (F10 or /aiadmin): a short guide sets the server name, where players start, starting money, how players interact and the world. Every value can be changed later.
SETUP_WELCOME_PLAYER: This server has not been set up yet. The owner sets it up from the admin panel (F10 or /aiadmin). Are you the owner? Add this line to permission.cfg, restart the server and join again: then the panel opens for you.
ADMIN_SETUP_DESC: The first settings of a new server, step by step. Every value saves at once and stays editable in its own tab.
ADMIN_SETUP_BANNER_DESC: Until it is finished every player sees a setup notice after spawning.
ADMIN_SETUP_SERVER_DESC: The name players see on the character screen and how many characters each may have.
ADMIN_SETUP_SPAWN_DESC: Where a new character appears. Stand there and use your position, or pick it with the free camera.
ADMIN_SETUP_MONEY_DESC: What a new character starts with and how often salaries are paid.
ADMIN_SETUP_JOBS_DESC: Whether a character can hold several jobs and gangs. Jobs themselves are in the Jobs tab.
ADMIN_SETUP_PLAY_DESC: How players use shops, doors and NPCs, and which inventory and key scripts are used.
ADMIN_SETUP_WORLD_DESC: GTA police, how busy the streets are and the seatbelt.
ADMIN_H_SETUP_DONE: Off: every player sees the setup notice after spawning and the panel opens on the setup guide.
ADMIN_H_HINT: When the HUD lists this key on the left of the screen. The script's choice, or your own.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_DESC: Online players first; every stored character by name, citizen id or identifier.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_SEARCH_HINT: A name, a citizen id, fivem:123, license:abc or discord:123
ADMIN_PLAYERS_SEARCH_SHORT: Type at least 2 characters to search every stored character.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_GONE_VIEW: This character does not exist any more.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ONLINE_ONLY: Only while the character is online.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_INFO_DESC: Name, birth date, nationality and sex. Scripts that copied the name see a change after the character loads again.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_H_SEX: Changes only while the character is offline (the ped model follows it).
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_ACCOUNT_DESC: The FiveM account this character belongs to.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_MONEY_DESC: Every change goes through the money system and lands in the ledger with your reason.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_JOBS_DESC: Jobs with their grade. One job is on duty at a time, and only while the character is online.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_GANGS_DESC: Gangs with their grade. The active gang is the one gang scripts see.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_NO_JOBS: No job: the character is unemployed.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_META_DESC: Values scripts keep on the character (hunger, thirst, stress...). Numbers, texts and switches can be changed; lists are shown as they are.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_POSITION_DESC: Online: where the player stands. Offline: where the character spawns next time; Bring moves that spot to you.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_NO_POSITION: No saved position: the character spawns at the default spawn.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_ITEMS_DESC: Give or take items through the running inventory.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_C_ACTIONS_DESC: Revive, kill or kick the player, or delete the character.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_KILL_DESC: The player's ped dies at once; the death script takes over as after any death.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_DELETE_DESC: The character leaves the player's character screen for good. Its row stays in the database for the logs.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_DELETE_ONLINE: Kick the player before deleting an online character.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_KICKED: You were kicked by an admin.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_KICKED_REASON: You were kicked by an admin: {0}
ADMIN_PLAYERS_NOTIFY_BROUGHT: An admin brought you to them.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_BUSY: The character is loading or saving. Try again in a moment.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_GONE: This character does not exist any more.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_WRITE: The database did not take the change. Nothing was changed.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_ONLINE: The character is online. Kick the player first.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_REASON: Write a reason of 3 to 64 characters.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_FUNDS: The account does not have that much.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_ACCOUNT: This account type does not exist.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_JOB: This job does not exist (the unemployed job is never given).
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_GRADE: This grade does not exist for it.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_LIMIT: The character already holds the most allowed.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_NOT_MEMBER: The character does not hold it.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_SEX_ONLINE: The sex changes only while the character is offline.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_POSITION: The character has no saved position.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_NO_DEATH: Revive needs a death script (ai-death) running.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_ITEM: The running inventory has no such item.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_ITEM_NONE: The player has none of it.
ADMIN_PLAYERS_ERR_INVENTORY: The inventory could not be opened.
BRIDGE_EXPLOIT_DROPPED: You were removed from the server for exploiting.
BRIDGE_NO_WAYPOINT: Set a waypoint on the map first.
VRP_KEY_MAIN_MENU: Open the main menu of vRP scripts
ADMIN_GRADE_PICK_FIRST: Pick a job or gang first
ADMIN_TAB_VRP_DESC: Decide who gets the permissions, groups and items that scripts made for the vRP framework ask for.
ADMIN_C_VRP_DEFAULTS_DESC: Used for every permission name that no rule below mentions.
ADMIN_F_VRP_JOB_PREFIX: Job permissions go to the job
ADMIN_H_VRP_JOB_PREFIX: A permission that starts with a job's name, like police.service, goes to members of that job.
ADMIN_H_VRP_JOB_ON_DUTY: Members get those job permissions only while they are on duty in that job.
ADMIN_H_VRP_ADMIN_PREFIX: A permission that starts with admin., like admin.tickets, goes to players with admin rights (ai.admin).
ADMIN_H_VRP_PLAYER_PREFIX: A permission that starts with player., like player.phone, goes to every player.
ADMIN_C_VRP_RULES_DESC: Give a permission name to a job, a gang, a group, the admins or everyone; for that name the built-in rules no longer count.
ADMIN_H_VRP_RULES: Several rules may name the same permission: whoever matches any of them has it. A name ending in * covers every permission that starts with it.
ADMIN_H_VRP_GRADE: This grade and every grade above it.
ADMIN_C_VRP_GROUPS_DESC: Link a group name scripts give or check to a job grade, a gang grade or admin; other names stay the character's own groups.
ADMIN_H_VRP_GROUPS: Giving a linked group sets that job or gang at that grade; checking it asks whether the character holds it.
ADMIN_C_VRP_ITEMS_DESC: Link an item name scripts use to an item of your inventory; names that already match an item need no line.
ADMIN_H_VRP_ITEMS: Without a line, wbody|WEAPON_X means the weapon item and other a|b names mean b.
ADMIN_C_VRP_SEEN_DESC: Every permission name your scripts have asked for; add a rule for one with a click.
ADMIN_H_VRP_SEEN: A new rule starts as admins only: pick who should have it in Permission rules.
ADMIN_ERR_VRP_GRADE: That job or gang has no such grade: lower the grade first, then pick the job or gang.
ADMIN_C_SPAWN_CHOICE_DESC: After picking a character the player chooses the last location or one of these points.
ADMIN_H_SPAWN_CHOOSE: On: a list of places shows after picking a character (needs at least one point below). Off: the character appears where it left.
SPAWN_CHOOSE_TITLE: Where do you want to appear?
ADMIN_H_ACCESS_JOBS: Only members of these jobs can use it. Leave jobs and gangs empty for everyone.
ADMIN_H_ACCESS_GANGS: Members of these gangs can use it too.
ADMIN_H_ACCESS_ON_DUTY: Job members must be on duty in that job.
ADMIN_C_PVP_DESC: Whether players can shoot and hit each other.
ADMIN_H_PVP: Off: weapons and fists do no harm between players (NPCs still take damage). /togglepvp flips it in game.
COMMAND_TOGGLEPVP: Turn player versus player damage on or off
NOTIFY_PVP_ON: PvP is on: players can hurt each other.
NOTIFY_PVP_OFF: PvP is off: players cannot hurt each other.
CORE_ERR_ARGS: A value given to ai-core is missing or not valid.
CORE_ERR_DEFINITION_PANEL: The admin panel already has a job or gang with this name: the panel one is used.
CORE_ERR_DEFINITION_OWNER: Another script already registered a job or gang with this name.
BAN_REFUSED: You are banned from this server. Reason: {0}. Ends: {1}. Ban id: {2}.
BAN_STARTING: The server is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
